text:
Before: avocado ~70g (~112 kcal), raisin toast ~60g (~170 kcal), muesli ~60g (~220 kcal), cappuccino ~250ml (~120 kcal), milk ~200ml in bottle, lemon.
After: milk partly consumed; probably some was poured into the muesli. The level dropped from about 200ml to about 150ml, so roughly 50ml was used (~32 kcal). Lemon was not eaten. Cappuccino, avocado, toast and muesli were all finished.

Total energy: 112+170+220+120+32 = 654 kcal.
Total mass: 70+60+60+250+50 = 490 g.
